1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 25 cm de longitud, de hocico corto, boca pequeña, ojos grandes, cuerpo plateado con bandas amarillas. Haemulidae Haemulon chrysargerum.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish reaching up to 25 cm in length, with a short snout, small mouth, large eyes, and a silver body with yellow stripes. Haemulidae Haemulon chrysargerum.
